comparison.objective: Remove a loaded drawer by simultaneously releasing two slide disconnects versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual simultaneous lever depression and controlled loaded-drawer pulling versus counterhold plus hex-key manipulation, fine collar rotation, locking, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer clears both slide stops while jars remain intact versus two safe stopping cycles and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual coordination, but simultaneous release-and-pull is meaningfully different from tool-mediated calibration. The record omits numeric synchronization, drawer-removal, jar-damage, and final-support thresholds.
